description: UK job ads from Gumtree, mostly local hourly and trade work, for a town, city or postcode (location, required) and an optional keyword (q): title, location (area, town), pay text as posted (e.g. £13/hour, up to £650/week), tags such as contract type and recruiter, featured flag, how long ago it was posted, ad ID and URL, about 30 per page (page 1 to 50), plus the total number of matching ads. Use it for local UK jobs by place; for UK professional roles use jobs_reed_co_uk or jobs_cv_library_uk_jobs. Read-only. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

location.description: Town, city or postcode, e.g. london, manchester, M1 (required)

q.description: Optional keyword, e.g. driver, cleaner, chef
